newsitem.title: USA: Calnetics to merge into Summa.
newsitem.headline: Calnetics to merge into Summa.

text.p: Calnetics Corp said it entered into a letter of intent to merge into Summa Industries for a combination of cash, debt and stock.

Under terms of the deal, Calnetics stockholders would receive $1.25 cash, $2.25 payable pursuant to a 10-year 5.5 percent subordinated convertible note, and Summa common stock worth $4.25 based on an average price over a defined period, for each Calnetics share held, the company said.
Calnetics and Summa are holding companies headquarted in the Los Angeles area whose subsidiaries make industrial and commercial plastic components.
The transaction was subject to certain conditions, including board and shareholder approval, they said.
The amount of Summa common stock Calnetics shareholders received would not be less than 0.57 or more than 0.77 of a Summa share for each Calnetics share, the companies said.
